== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Li]] clan is a family located in [[Sacred Valley]] that has experienced a decline in status, falling out of the top ten families in the region. They are characterized by an ostentatious and sophisticated culture, often utilizing musical performances and colorful [[Remnants]]—such as silver butterflies and Jade{{!}}jade hawks—to create elaborate displays. Their members are known for wearing significant amounts of jewelry, including gold and silver, with high-ranking [[Jade]] elders wearing numerous rings in their ears and on their fingers. While some view this as a sign of vanity and arrogance, the clan maintains a proud identity, boasting one of the largest collections of flying chariots and clouds in the valley. Their territory features a decorative wooden wall designed to resemble a serpent. Notable figures include [[Shao]], an expert [[Forger]], and the [[Grand Patriarch]], an ancient immortal whose return caused significant alarm. The clan's leadership includes a Jai Matriarch{{!}}Matriarch and various elders, such as the Fourth Elder. Historically, the clan was led by [[Li Markuth]], a [[Grand Elder]] who sought to reclaim the family's former dominance and challenge the [[Wei clan]] for leadership of the valley.}}

== Unsouled ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|The [[Li]] clan, which represents itself with the colors green and gray in the arena, failed to make any moves to increase its strength prior to the [[Festival]]. Led by [[Grand Patriarch]] [[Li Markuth]], the clan possesses various experts under its command. During the events of the competition, the [[Grand Patriarch]] demonstrated his power by summoning dark clouds.}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|The [[Li clan]] has experts and a [[Grand Patriarch]].<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c9">''Unsouled'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>

== Bloodline ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Located to the south of the valley, the [[Li]] clan is a group visited by [[Lindon]]. The settlement is enclosed by walls made of smooth, pale, polished wood that feature functional Script{{!}}script decorations. Led by a Jai Matriarch{{!}}Matriarch and including a Fourth Elder, the clan has participated in the [[Seven-Year Festival]]. Although [[Lindon]] initially held negative impressions of them, the clan proved to be better than he had anticipated. However, a member of the clan eventually collapsed while bleeding from his eyes.}}
